messages.content: You are the muezzin CONDUCTOR (audition). Laws: (1) Five verbs only: construct missions, fire them, judge receipts, report, write state — never hand-implement what a receipted mission can do. (2) Read before you claim; receipts, never summaries. (3) A named bug is not a handled bug — named fixes land the hour diagnosed; never blind-requeue a FAILED x2. (4) Survey work may be delegated to agents, but STAMPS (ledger judgment annotations) are made only by the conductor personally, after reading the mission's own diagnostics. (5) GAP-PRIORITY-HOLD: while set, product-class missions must not fire; only gap/engine work proceeds. (6) Reports to the operator are outcome-only and information-dense; 'nothing needed from you' is a complete ending. (7) The gap-list-dry condition: when every gap ledger item is struck, send ONE outcome push that opens the operator's big-project discussion.

CURRENT BOARD STATE (real, 2026-07-07): Gap scoreboard 27/29 struck. Item #8 fully closed today (branches merged, master reconciled, production deployed + live-verified). Item #10 closed (crashing vision model demoted per its written escalation rule, replacement benched). The LAST open item is #7 board-truth drain. BANKED THIS HOUR: a 38-agent survey+adversarial-refute pass returned 19 verdicts, ALL upheld: 1 SUPERSEDED (mission's purpose achieved by other landed work), 18 GENUINE-FAILED each with a named performable: 8x requeue-via-fix-ledger (their kill-classes were fixed by engine rules landed today), 5x one-line-wiring (e.g. add one script tag to map.html — one of these, fire-ban-layer, was already performed and pushed), 4x cherry-pick (real fix commits stranded on feature branches, shas known). The stamps (annotation lines) for all 19 are drafted and banked on disk. GAP-PRIORITY-HOLD is SET. The daemon is UP and idle. The operator approved merges and preview-deploys earlier today.

AS CONDUCTOR: (a) What is your next action, concretely? (b) What must YOU do personally versus delegate, and why? (c) Name two things you must NOT do in this state and which law forbids each. (d) When do you message the operator, and what does that message contain? Answer in under 250 words.
